text:
Zoe Kim: Postmortem follow-up: recurring cache eviction spikes tied to nightly data imports. Need clear owners for runbook edits, an alert, and an RFC for job gating.
Alan Wu: I can handle the runbook edits and short oncall cheat-sheet. Will add pasteable commands by EOD Thu.
Alan Wu: Commands to include:
```bash
# hotlist nodes/pods
kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr
kubectl top pods -n inference | grep kv-cache
# tail cache logs quickly
kubectl logs -n inference deploy/kv-cache --tail=100
```
Tess: monitor-bot opened INC-2601 and linked a runbook draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/79
monitor-bot: Created Jira INC-2601: "Runbook + alerting for nightly cache evictions" assigned to Alan Wu, due 2026-04-07.
Priya: I'll take the Grafana/Prometheus alert. Suggest two thresholds: warning at 8 evictions/5m, critical at 25 evictions/5m aggregated. Draft rule by next Mon.
Zoe Kim: Add immediate mitigation steps to playbook: reduce route batch_size, rotate cache pods, and failover heavy routes to smaller model variants. Example commands are enough for oncall.
Alan Wu: Adding a short escalation order: infra-oncall -> platform -> SRE lead, and include phone/pager links.
Priya: I'll also add a dashboard panel for the recurring-window pattern and set a weekly report.
Zoe Kim: Owners summary to copy into INC-2601: runbook/playbook: Alan Wu  due 2026-03-29; alert/dashboard: Priya  due 2026-04-01; RFC for job gating: Zoe Kim  RFC due 2026-04-10.
Alan Wu: ack, will paste minimal commands and a one-sheet for oncall.
Tess: I'll review the PR and add reviewers. Also will include a tiny "cheatsheet.md" in the runbooks repo.
Zoe Kim: Thanks — I'll follow up mid-week and flag blockers.
